versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν σαββάτῳ διαπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν διὰ σπορίμων, καὶ ἔτιλλον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤσθιον τοὺς στάχυας ψώχοντες ταῖς χερσίν.

controles.web: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, no sábado, Jesus passou pelas plantações, e seus discípulos iam arrancando espigas, e comiam, debulhando-as com as mãos.

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ τῶν Φαρισαίων εἶπαν Τί ποιεῖτε ὃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν;

controles.web: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
controles.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
controles.livre: E alguns dos fariseus disseram: Por que fazeis o que não é lícito nos sábados?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδὲ τοῦτο ἀνέγνωτε ὃ ἐποίησεν Δαυεὶδ ὁπότε ἐπείνασεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὄντες;

controles.web: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Nunca lestes isto, o que Davi fez quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?

versos.grego: ὡς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως λαβὼν ἔφαγεν καὶ ἔδωκεν τοῖς μετ’ αὐτοῦ, οὓς οὐκ ἔξεστιν φαγεῖν εἰ μὴ μόνους τοὺς ἱερεῖς;

controles.web: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
controles.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
controles.livre: Como entrou na casa de Deus, tomou, e comeu os pães da apresentação, e deu aos que estavam com ele, pães que não é lícito comer, a não ser só os sacerdotes?

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Κύριός ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
controles.livre: E dizia-lhes: O Filho do homem é Senhor do sábado.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ἑτέρῳ σαββάτῳ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν καὶ διδάσκειν· καὶ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ καὶ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ ἡ δεξιὰ ἦν ξηρά·

controles.web: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
controles.livre: E aconteceu em outro sábado que entrou na sinagoga, e estava ensinado; e ali estava um homem que tinha a mão direita definhada.

versos.grego: παρετηροῦντο δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι εἰ ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεύει, ἵνα εὕρωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
controles.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
controles.livre: E os escribas e fariseus o observavam, se o curaria no sábado; para acharem de que o acusar.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς δὲ ᾔδει τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς αὐτῶν, εἶπεν δὲ τῷ ἀνδρὶ τῷ ξηρὰν ἔχοντι τὴν χεῖρα Ἔγειρε καὶ στῆθι εἰς τὸ μέσον· καὶ ἀναστὰς ἔστη.

controles.web: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up, and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
controles.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
controles.livre: Mas ele bem sabia dos seus pensamentos; e disse ao homem que tinha a mão definhada: Levanta-te, e põe-te em pé no meio. E ele se levantou e se pôs de pé.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτούς Ἐπερωτῶ ὑμᾶς εἰ ἔξεστιν τῷ σαββάτῳ ἀγαθοποιῆσαι ἢ κακοποιῆσαι, ψυχὴν σῶσαι ἢ ἀπολέσαι;

controles.web: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
controles.livre: Então Jesus lhes disse: Eu vos pergunto: É lícito no sábado fazer bem, ou fazer mal? Salvar uma pessoa, ou matá-la?

versos.grego: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος πάντας αὐτοὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου. ὁ δὲ ἐποίησεν, καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
controles.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
controles.livre: E ele, olhando para todos em redor, disse-lhe: Estende a tua mão. E ele o fez; e a mão foi lhe restituída.

versos.grego: αὐτοὶ δὲ ἐπλήσθησαν ἀνοίας, καὶ διελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους τί ἂν ποιήσαιεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
controles.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
controles.livre: Então encheram-se de ira; e conversaram uns com os outros sobre o que fariam a Jesus.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι, καὶ ἦν διανυκτερεύων ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que naqueles dias ele foi ao monte para orar; e passou a noite orando a Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡμέρα, προσεφώνησεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκλεξάμενος ἀπ’ αὐτῶν δώδεκα, οὓς καὶ ἀποστόλους ὠνόμασεν,

controles.web: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
controles.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
controles.livre: E quando já era dia, chamou a si os seus discípulos, e escolheu doze deles, a quem também chamou de apóstolos:

versos.grego: Σίμωνα, ὃν καὶ ὠνόμασεν, Πέτρον καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάνην, καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Βαρθολομαῖον,

controles.web: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
controles.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
controles.livre: Simão, a quem também chamou de Pedro, e seu irmão André; Tiago, e João; Filipe, e Bartolomeu.

versos.grego: καὶ Μαθθαῖον καὶ Θωμᾶν, καὶ Ἰάκωβον Ἀλφαίου καὶ Σίμωνα τὸν καλούμενον Ζηλωτὴν,

controles.web: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;
controles.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon called Zelotes,
controles.livre: Mateus, Tomé; Tiago filho de Alfeu, e Simão chamado “o Zelote”.

versos.grego: καὶ Ἰούδαν Ἰακώβου, καὶ Ἰούδαν Ἰσκαριὼθ, ὃς ἐγένετο προδότης,

controles.web: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
controles.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
controles.livre: Judas de Tiago, e Judas Iscariotes, o que foi o traidor.

versos.grego: καὶ καταβὰς μετ’ αὐτῶν ἔστη ἐπὶ τόπου πεδινοῦ, καὶ ὄχλος πολὺς μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ πλῆθος πολὺ τοῦ λαοῦ ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ τῆς παραλίου Τύρου καὶ Σιδῶνος,

controles.web: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;
controles.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
controles.livre: Ele desceu com eles, parou num lugar plano, e também com ele uma grande quantidade dos seus discípulos, e grande multidão do povo de toda a Judeia, de Jerusalém, da costa marítima de Tiro, e de Sidom,

versos.grego: οἳ ἦλθον ἀκοῦσαι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰαθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν νόσων αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ ἐνοχλούμενοι ἀπὸ πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων ἐθεραπεύοντο·

controles.web: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.
controles.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
controles.livre: que tinham vindo para o ouvir, e para serem curados das suas enfermidades, como também os atormentados por espíritos imundos foram curados.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἐζήτουν ἅπτεσθαι αὐτοῦ, ὅτι δύναμις παρ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξήρχετο καὶ ἰᾶτο πάντας.

controles.web: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
controles.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
controles.livre: E toda a multidão procurava tocá-lo; porque dele saía poder, e curava a todos.

versos.grego: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἔλεγεν Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοί, ὅτι ὑμετέρα ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said,  “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.
controles.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Ele levantou os olhos aos seus discípulos, e disse: Benditos  sois vós, os pobres, porque o Reino de Deus é vosso.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες νῦν, ὅτι χορτασθήσεσθε. μακάριοι οἱ κλαίοντες νῦν, ὅτι γελάσετε.

controles.web: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
controles.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
controles.livre: Benditos sois vós que agora tendes fome, porque sereis saciados. Benditos sois vós que agora chorais, porque rireis.

versos.grego: μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν μισήσωσιν ὑμᾶς οἱ ἄνθρωποι, καὶ ὅταν ἀφορίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ ὀνειδίσωσιν καὶ ἐκβάλωσιν τὸ ὄνομα ὑμῶν ὡς πονηρὸν ἕνεκα τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
controles.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.
controles.livre: Benditos sereis quando as pessoas vos odiarem, quando vos separarem, vos insultarem, e rejeitarem o vosso nome como mau, por causa do Filho do homem.

versos.grego: χάρητε ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ σκιρτήσατε· ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ· κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς προφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
controles.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
controles.livre: Contentai-vos nesse dia, e saltai de alegria, porque eis que grande é a vossa recompensa nos céus; pois assim os pais deles faziam aos profetas.

versos.grego: Πλὴν οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς πλουσίοις, ὅτι ἀπέχετε τὴν παράκλησιν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
controles.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
controles.livre: Mas ai de vós, ricos, porque já tendes a vossa consolação.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, οἱ ἐμπεπλησμένοι νῦν, ὅτι πεινάσετε. οὐαί, οἱ γελῶντες νῦν, ὅτι πενθήσετε καὶ κλαύσετε.

controles.web: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
controles.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
controles.livre: Ai de vós que estais saciados, porque tereis fome. Ai de vós que agora rides, porque lamentareis, e chorareis.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὅταν καλῶς ὑμᾶς εἴπωσιν πάντες οἱ ἄνθρωποι· κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς ψευδοπροφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Woe,whenmen speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
controles.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
controles.livre: Ai de vós quando todos falarem bem de vós; porque assim os pais deles faziam aos falsos profetas.

versos.grego: Ἀλλὰ ὑμῖν λέγω τοῖς ἀκούουσιν Ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν, καλῶς ποιεῖτε τοῖς μισοῦσιν ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
controles.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
controles.livre: Mas a vós, que estais ouvindo, digo: amai os vossos inimigos; fazei bem aos que vos odeiam;

versos.grego: εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς καταρωμένους ὑμᾶς, προσεύχεσθε περὶ τῶν ἐπηρεαζόντων ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
controles.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
controles.livre: bendizei aos que vos maldizem, e orai pelos que vos maltratam.

versos.grego: τῷ τύπτοντί σε ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα πάρεχε καὶ τὴν ἄλλην, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἴροντός σου τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα μὴ κωλύσῃς.

controles.web: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
controles.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
controles.livre: Ao que te ferir numa face, oferece-lhe também a outra; e ao que te tirar a capa, não recuses a túnica.

versos.grego: παντὶ αἰτοῦντί σε δίδου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἴροντος τὰ σὰ μὴ ἀπαίτει.

controles.web: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
controles.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
controles.livre: Dá a quem te pedir; e ao que te tomar o que é teu, não o peças de volta.

versos.grego: καὶ καθὼς θέλετε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς ὁμοίως.

controles.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
controles.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
controles.livre: E como vós quereis que as pessoas vos façam, fazei-lhes vós também da mesma maneira.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν; καὶ γὰρ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας αὐτοὺς ἀγαπῶσιν.

controles.web: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
controles.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
controles.livre: E se amardes aos que vos amam, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores amam os que os amam.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἐὰν ἀγαθοποιῆτε τοὺς ἀγαθοποιοῦντας ὑμᾶς, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν; καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν.

controles.web: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
controles.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
controles.livre: E se fizerdes bem aos que vos fazem bem, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores fazem o mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν δανίσητε παρ’ ὧν ἐλπίζετε λαβεῖν, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν; καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς δανίζουσιν ἵνα ἀπολάβωσιν τὰ ἴσα.

controles.web: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
controles.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
controles.livre: E se emprestardes àqueles de quem esperais receber de volta, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores emprestam aos pecadores, para receberam de volta o tanto equivalente.

versos.grego: πλὴν ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν καὶ ἀγαθοποιεῖτε καὶ δανίζετε μηδὲν ἀπελπίζοντες· καὶ ἔσται ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολύς, καὶ ἔσεσθε υἱοὶ Ὑψίστου, ὅτι αὐτὸς χρηστός ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀχαρίστους καὶ πονηρούς.

controles.web: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
controles.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
controles.livre: Em vez disso, amai aos vossos inimigos, fazei o bem, e emprestai, sem nada esperar disso; e grande será a vossa recompensa, e sereis filhos do Altíssimo; porque é benigno até para com os ingratos e maus.

versos.grego: Γίνεσθε οἰκτίρμονες, καθὼς ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν οἰκτίρμων ἐστίν.

controles.web: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
controles.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
controles.livre: Portanto, sede misericordiosos, como também o vosso Pai é misericordioso.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ κρίνετε, καὶ οὐ μὴ κριθῆτε· καὶ μὴ καταδικάζετε, καὶ οὐ μὴ καταδικασθῆτε. ἀπολύετε, καὶ ἀπολυθήσεσθε·

controles.web: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
controles.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
controles.livre: Não julgueis, e não sereis julgados; não condeneis, e não sereis condenados; liberai, e vos liberarão.

versos.grego: δίδοτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· μέτρον καλὸν πεπιεσμένον σεσαλευμένον ὑπερεκχυννόμενον δώσουσιν εἰς τὸν κόλπον ὑμῶν· ᾧ γὰρ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε ἀντιμετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν.

controles.web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
controles.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
controles.livre: Dai, e será vos dado; medida boa, comprimida, sacudida e transbordante vos darão no vosso colo; pois com a mesma medida que medirdes vos medirão de volta.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς Μήτι δύναται τυφλὸς τυφλὸν ὁδηγεῖν; οὐχὶ ἀμφότεροι εἰς βόθυνον ἐμπεσοῦνται;

controles.web: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
controles.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
controles.livre: E disse-lhes uma parábola: Acaso pode o cego guiar outro cego? Não cairão ambos no buraco?

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν μαθητὴς ὑπὲρ τὸν διδάσκαλον· κατηρτισμένος δὲ πᾶς ἔσται ὡς ὁ διδάσκαλος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
controles.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
controles.livre: O discípulo não está acima do seu mestre; mas todo aquele que estiver completamente capacitado será como o seu mestre.

versos.grego: Τί δὲ βλέπεις τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου, τὴν δὲ δοκὸν τὴν ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ ὀφθαλμῷ οὐ κατανοεῖς;

controles.web: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
controles.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
controles.livre: E por que tu prestas atenção no cisco que está no olho do teu irmão, e não enxergas a trave que está no teu próprio olho?

versos.grego: πῶς δύνασαι λέγειν τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου Ἀδελφέ, ἄφες ἐκβάλω τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ σου, αὐτὸς τὴν ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ σοῦ δοκὸν οὐ βλέπων; ὑποκριτά, ἔκβαλε πρῶτον τὴν δοκὸν ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σοῦ, καὶ τότε διαβλέψεις τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἐκβαλεῖν.

controles.web: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
controles.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.
controles.livre: Ou como podes dizer a teu irmão: “Irmão, deixa-me tirar o cisco que está no teu olho”, se tu mesmo não prestas atenção na trave que está no teu olho? Hipócrita, tira primeiro a trave de teu olho, e então verás bem para tirar o cisco que está no olho do teu irmão.

versos.grego: Οὐ γάρ ἐστιν δένδρον καλὸν ποιοῦν καρπὸν σαπρόν, οὐδὲ πάλιν δένδρον σαπρὸν ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλόν.

controles.web: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
controles.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
controles.livre: Pois não há boa árvore que dê mau fruto, nem árvore má que dê bom fruto.

versos.grego: ἕκαστον γὰρ δένδρον ἐκ τοῦ ἰδίου καρποῦ γινώσκεται· οὐ γὰρ ἐξ ἀκανθῶν συλλέγουσιν σῦκα, οὐδὲ ἐκ βάτου σταφυλὴν τρυγῶσιν.

controles.web: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
controles.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
controles.livre: Porque cada árvore se conhece pelo seu próprio fruto; pois não se colhem figos dos espinheiros, nem se tiram uvas dos abrolhos.

versos.grego: ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ θησαυροῦ τῆς καρδίας προφέρει τὸ ἀγαθόν, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ προφέρει τὸ πονηρόν· ἐκ γὰρ περισσεύματος καρδίας λαλεῖ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
controles.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
controles.livre: A boa pessoa tira o bem do bom tesouro do seu coração, e a pessoa má tira o mal do mau tesouro do seu coração; pois a sua boca fala daquilo que o coração tem em abundância.

versos.grego: Τί δέ με καλεῖτε Κύριε κύριε, καὶ οὐ ποιεῖτε ἃ λέγω;

controles.web: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
controles.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
controles.livre: E por que me chamais: “Senhor!”, “Senhor!”, e não fazeis o que eu digo?

versos.grego: Πᾶς ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρός με καὶ ἀκούων μου τῶν λόγων καὶ ποιῶν αὐτούς, ὑποδείξω ὑμῖν τίνι ἐστὶν ὅμοιος.

controles.web: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words, and does them, I will show you who he is like.
controles.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
controles.livre: Todo aquele que vem a mim, ouve as minhas palavras, e as pratica, eu vos mostrarei a quem é semelhante:

versos.grego: ὅμοιός ἐστιν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδομοῦντι οἰκίαν, ὃς ἔσκαψεν καὶ ἐβάθυνεν καὶ ἔθηκεν θεμέλιον ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν· πλημμύρης δὲ γενομένης προσέρηξεν ὁ ποταμὸς τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσεν σαλεῦσαι αὐτὴν διὰ τὸ καλῶς οἰκοδομῆσθαι αὐτήν.

controles.web: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep, and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
controles.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
controles.livre: Semelhante é ao homem que construiu uma casa, cavou, abriu bem fundo, e pôs o fundamento sobre a rocha; e quando veio a enchente, a corrente bateu com ímpeto naquela casa, e não a pôde abalar, porque estava fundada sobre a rocha.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας καὶ μὴ ποιήσας ὅμοιός ἐστιν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδομήσαντι οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν χωρὶς θεμελίου, ᾗ προσέρηξεν ὁ ποταμός, καὶ εὐθὺς συνέπεσεν, καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ ῥῆγμα τῆς οἰκίας ἐκείνης μέγα.

controles.web: But he who hears, and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great.”
controles.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que ouve e não pratica é semelhante ao homem que construiu uma casa sobre a terra, sem fundamento, na qual a corrente bateu com ímpeto, e logo caiu; e foi grande a queda daquela casa.
